1. Please check whether the cleaning tray is installed correctly.
2. Please check whether the buoy in the cleaning tray is installed correctly.
3. If the cleaning tray is in place and water accumulates in the cleaning tray:
a. Check whether the door latch

1. Check whether the door latch of the dirty water tank is fastened when it is installed on the station.
2. Che

What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports tips 6030:The station's cleaning tray is not installed, please check?
1. Please check whether the cleaning tray is installed correctly.

What should I do if the charging base of the eufy Clean X10 Pro Omni(T2351) gets dirty and wet?

1. Inspect the components of the clean water tank
